page.layout: One printed page of title text, centred, with a woodcut coat of arms (a bear) between the middle lines and the imprint. No running head, page number or margin text.
page.notes: Woodcut between "le Lausannensis." and "LAVSANNAE,": a shield with a bear walking across a diagonal band, within a decorative scrolled border. It is an engraving, not text. The imprint date is printed as cIↄ cI LXXVI; the second group is hard to read and is given as MDLXXVI, with [?]. Handwritten "11" at top right and show-through text on the right and left edges are not transcribed.
